name: Breaker-open earthing interlock
summary: Uses the assigned breaker state as one condition of earthing-switch operation.
description: Uses the assigned breaker state as one condition of earthing-switch operation. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Breaker open indication” at the input and “Earthing operation condition” at the output. Breaker opening alone does not establish isolation.
